questions.expl: ：我现在正作为一名交换生在俄罗斯学习。 a 一个(表泛指，用于以辅音音素发音开头的单词前)；an 一个(表泛指，用于以元音音素发音开 头的单词前)；the 这(表特指)；/不填。根据“as...exchange student”可知，此处泛指一名交换生， 空后是以元音音素开头的单词exchange，所以空处应是an。故选B。
：其中一个最大的不同之处就是人们的生活方式。 big 大的(原级)；bigger 更大的(比较级)；biggest 最大的(最高级，前面应加the)；the biggest 最大的(最高级)。根据“One of...differences”可知，此处可用“one of+the+形容词最高级+名词复数”， 表示“最……之一”。故选D。

：我想着尝试一下当地的食物。 expect 期待(原形)；expects 期待(三单形式)；expected 期待(过去式)；am expecting 正期待 着(现在进行时结构)。结合上文“One day, a Russian friend invited me to a well-known restaurant in Moscow.”和下文“After arriving there, I found nothing on the table but some small plates.”，可知此句应 用一般过去时，空处应用动词过去式expected。故选C。
：更让我惊讶的是，盘子上只有几片西红柿、坚果和几片洋葱。 has 有(三单形式)；had 有(过去式)；was 是(主语为单数)；were 是(主语是第二人称或复 数)。根据“there...only a few slices of tomatoes”可知，此处可用there be 句型，且就近的名词是复数， 空处应是be 动词were。故选D。
：尽管菜肴很简单，但我们喝了很多，并且我能感受到他内心里的热情。 Although 尽管；But 但是；So 所以；And 并且。根据“...the dishes were simple, we drank a lot”可知， 前后句意存在让步关系，空处应是although，引导让步状语从句，表示尽管菜肴很简单，但也喝了 很多。故选A。
：在中国，当我们邀请朋友或亲戚时，我们总是会给他们提供上一顿丰盛的晚餐，里面有 各种各样的菜肴。

questions.stem: A．as many food as B．so many food as
questions.expl: ：我们喜欢准备尽可能多的食物来表示我们的友好。 as many food as 错误用法，many 不能修饰不可数名词food；so many food as 错误用法，many 不能 修饰不可数名词food；so much food as 尽可能多的食物(so...as 用于否定句中)；as much food as 尽可能多的食物(as...as 用于肯定句或否定句中)。根据“We like to prepare...we can to show our friendliness.”可知，该句为肯定句，空处应是as much food as。故选D。

：另一个俄罗斯的习俗也让我大吃一惊。 Another 另一个(用于三者及以上)；Other 别的，另外的(后面常接名词复数)；The other 另一 个(两者中的另外一个)；The others 其余的全部。根据“...Russian custom also surprises me greatly.” 可知，空后的Russian custom 为名词单数，且结合常识，俄罗斯的习俗应有不少(不至于少于三个)， 所以空处应是another，符合语境。故选A。
：正如我们所知，那里的冬天非常寒冷，以至于仅仅是外出都要花很大的勇气。 very 非常；quite 相当地；so 如此；such 这样地。根据“it is...cold in winter there that it takes a lot of courage to just go outside”可知，此处可用so...that...“太……以至于……”。故选C。
：然而，当冬天来时，俄罗斯人很喜欢游泳。 swim 游泳(原形)；swam 游泳(过去式)；to swim 游泳(不定式)；swimming 游泳(动名词/ 现在分词)。根据“Russians enjoy...”可知，此处可用enjoy doing sth.“享受做某事，喜欢做某事”， 空处应是动名词swimming。故选D。
：俄罗斯的孩子们在跳入水之前用雪来擦他们的身体。 with 用；by 被；in 在……里面；through 穿过。根据“Russian kids rub (揉擦) their bodies...snow”可知， 此处表示用雪来揉擦身体，空处应是with，符合语境。故选A。
：水是冰冷的，但他们都在水里面玩得很兴奋！ excited 兴奋的(形容词)；excitedly 兴奋地(副词)；excite 使兴奋(动词)；excitement 兴奋(名 词)。根据“they all play...in it”可知，空处应填入副词excitedly，修饰动词play。故选B。

：因为我们真的很难像他们一样，如此享受在冰冷的水里玩耍。 enjoy 享受(原形)；enjoyed 享受(过去式)；to enjoy 享受(不定式)；enjoying 享受(现在分 词/动名词)。根据“it is really difficult for us...it”可知，此处可用“it is+形容词+for sb. to do sth.”，表 示“对某人而言，做某事是……的”，空处应是不定式to enjoy。故选C。
：我已从这次交流访问中学习到了很多。
：这次访问多有趣啊！ How 引导感叹句，后接形容词/副词；How an 错误用法；What 引导感叹句，后接不可数名词/名词 复数；What an 引导感叹句，后接名词单数。根据“...interesting the visit is!”可知，此句是感叹句， 句式为“how+形容词+主谓”。故选A。
：她将作为交换生在那里待一年。 British 英国；French 法国；exchange 交换；homestay 寄宿家庭。根据“a young girl named Maria arrived from Britain. She would stay there as a/an...student for one year”可知，她将作为交换生在那里待一年。 故选C。
：起初，玛丽亚对新环境感到担忧，并试图适应法国的文化和语言。 worried 担心的；silly 愚蠢的；comfortable 舒适的；confident 自信的。根据“and tried to get used to the French culture and language”可知起初，玛丽亚对新环境感到担忧。故选A。
：但她的老师和同学都乐于助人。 happy 快乐的；wonderful 精彩的；interesting 有趣的；helpful 乐助人的。根据“With their help, Maria overcame(克服) a lot of difficulties.”可知，她的老师和同学都乐于助人。故选D。
：她游览了巴黎，对法国有了更多的了解。 toured 游览；rode 骑行；drove 驾驶；flew 飞行。根据“She visited museums, attended concerts and walked along the Seine river.”可知，她游览了巴黎。故选A。
：她非常喜欢这座城市的美丽。 introduced 介绍；enjoyed 喜欢；remembered 记住；improved 改进。根据“the beauty of the city a lot” 可知，喜欢这座城市的美丽。故选B。
：她感到有点难过。 angry 愤怒的；sad 悲伤的；amazed 惊讶的；glad 高兴的。根据“A year later, it was time for Maria to leave.”和“She would miss her friends and the city which had become her second home.”可知，离别的时 候，她感到有点难过，故选B。

：她很感激有意义的经历和宝贵的友谊。 challenges 挑战；skills 技能；experiences 经历；classes 课程。根据“In the heart of Paris, a school welcomes students from all around the world. One day, a young girl named Maria arrived from Britain.” 可知，这是有意义的经历。故选C。
：几年后，玛丽亚作为一名成功的女商人回到了巴黎。
：幸运的是，她遇到了一些以前的同学和老师。 hardly 几乎不；specially 特别；luckily 幸运地；quietly 安静地。根据“met some of her former classmates and teachers”可知，她遇到了一些以前的同学和老师是幸运的事。故选C。
：她对教育交流的培养表示感谢。 development 培养；power 力量；method 方法；secret 秘密。根据“of the educational exchange”可知， 教育交流属于培养方式。故选A。

questions.stem: What was the main purpose of the Thompsons serving baked beans?
opts: To make fun of Chinese eating habits.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“‘No! Mum thought you might miss Chinese breakfasts. She read online that beans are popular in Shanghai!’ Xia realized Mrs. Thompson had mixed up Shanghai’s sweet red bean desserts with British baked beans.”可知，Mrs. Thompson 在网上读到“豆类在上海很受欢迎”，误以为上海的 甜红豆甜品与英国的咸烤豆是同类食物，因此特意准备烤豆子以贴近林夏的家乡口味，这一件事正 好体现了文化误解的细节。故选B。

questions.stem: Which of the following is closest in meaning to the underlined phrase “mixed up” in Paragraph 2?
Why did Xia avoid disagreeing with her teammates in the beginning?
opts: She lacked confidence in her English.
She valued team harmony over debate.
She disliked the teacher’s intervention (干涉).
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“While her British teammates freely debated (辩论) ideas, Xia hesitated (犹豫) to disagree with others, remembering her teachers’ advice in China: ‘Group harmony matters most.’”可知， 林夏因受中国老师“团队和谐最重要”的教导影响，不愿公开反驳他人观点，可见她在辩论中重视团 队和谐。故选C。

questions.stem: Which lesson did Xia learn from her experience?
opts: Perfect understanding between cultures is impossible.
Adaptation and communication bridge cultural differences.
Western education systems are better than others.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“‘Cultural exchange isn’t about being perfect,’ she wrote in her diary. ‘It’s about listening, adapting (适应), and finding joy in the messy middle.’”可知，林夏在日记中总结道，文化交 流的关键是“倾听、适应并享受过程中的不完美”，即“适应和沟通是文化差异的桥梁。”。故选C。

questions.stem: How does the author organize the passage?
opts: By comparing British and Chinese customs.
By asking questions and answering them.
Through a personal growth story with examples.
Through historical data of exchange programs.
questions.expl: 判断题。文章通过林夏的两次具体经历(早餐误解、课堂辩论)展现她的成长过程，属于 “个人故事结合实例”的结构。故选C。

questions.stem: What is the culture shock to the writer in Italy?
opts: Italians are hard to get on with.
Italians stand quite closely to each other.
Italian scenery is not as beautiful as imagined.
Italians are against learning foreign languages.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Where I’m from, knocking into someone or standing very closely is considered quite impolite. This is different from the truth in Italy.”可知在意大利，人们站的很近，这和作者的家 乡不一样。故选B。

questions.stem: ________ helped the writer understand what Italians were saying.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Italians like to speak with their hands—a habit I’ve carried over till this day. Gestures can express general ideas and feelings.”可知手势帮助作者理解意大利人在说什么。故选B。

questions.stem: When arriving in China, the writer ________.
opts: began to buy many things online
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“Years later, when I moved to China, my experience was special. The culture there was something very foreign to me”可知几年后，当作者回到中国时，那里的文化对作者来说很陌生， 可见作者又经历了文化冲击。故选C。

questions.stem: What does the last paragraph mainly tell us?
opts: How to deal with different cultures.
The trouble of travelling around the world.
How to search for a best place to visit.
The value of experiencing culture shock.
questions.expl: 大意题。根据“ the greatest reward of travel is…to be in a position in which almost nothing is so familiar that it is taken for granteds … to be in a position in which almost nothing is so familiar that it is taken for granted”可知，此处是在解释经历不同文化的价值所在。故选D。

questions.stem: Which is the right structure of the passage?(①-Paragraph 1,②-Paragraph 2,... )
questions.expl: 结构题。第一段提出文化冲击这个话题；第二三四段介绍了作者在意大利所经历的文化冲 击；第五第六段介绍了作者重新回到中国的经历；第七段总结经历不同文化的价值。故选项A 符 合文章结构。故选A。

questions.stem: Many foreigners think that Chinese hosts are the ________ in the world.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“In the eyes of many foreigners, Chinese are the best hosts (主人) and the worst guests in the world.”可知，许多外国人认为中国人是世界上最好的主人。故选A。

questions.stem: If the writer’s guests want to smoke in his house, what will he probably say?
opts: It’s OK if you smoke here.
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“When I see some of her guests smoking in her house, as non-smoker, I feel unhappy. Usually I want to stop them directly.”可推知，作者不会让客人在家里抽烟，客人想抽烟的话， 他会阻止他们。故选C。

questions.stem: What is the meaning of the underlined phrase “adapt to” in the passage?
Which of the following sentences is TRUE according to the passage?
opts: You feel surprised if your international guests don’t bring you a gift to your home.
The writer often smokes in his mother’s house.
You are a bad guest if the north Americans allow you to smoke in their house.
Guest are almost like gods in China.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“In China, guests are almost like gods.”可知，在中国，客人像上帝。故选D。

questions.stem: What is the main idea of this passage?
opts: Hosts must do things in the guest’s way.
Western hosts are always nice to guests.
questions.expl: 大意题。通读全文可知，本文主要介绍了中西方待人接物的不同，告诉我们应该多了解不 同国家的不同文化。故选D。
